weaponTypeId.description: Weapon type identity. Omitted only for legacy unclassified content.

range.description: Legacy single reach. Prefer minimumRange and maximumRange; when only this is present it means a band of 1 to range.

minimumRange.description: Closest tile distance this weapon can strike. A bow with minimumRange 3 cannot hit an adjacent enemy.

maximumRange.description: Furthest tile distance this weapon can strike.

accuracy.description: How often this weapon lands, as a whole percentage. Omitted means 100: it always lands and rolls nothing. Anything below rolls once per strike, and the number a player is shown is this number.
